notes: Evidence only exists for the degree programme named in the task ("Bachelor's in Computational Business Analytics (BSc)", DAAD page). The other supplied pages describe different programmes (Bachelor in Artificial Intelligence & Data Engineering, Master of Finance, MBAs, Bankfachwirt), so their fees, deadlines, language requirements and document lists are NOT used here. No tuition figure for this programme could be quoted: the only fee statement found ("all countries 8,200 EUR" on the DAAD page) belongs to the Computational Business Analytics page but is expressed as "Tuition fees per semester" and is immediately followed by "Tuition fees may vary", so a per-year amount cannot be stated without inventing one. No intake dates could be quoted either: the pages for this programme only give "the application deadline is at the end of June" (no day, no year) and "Our application platform opens in September" (no year), plus the FS AIDE page shows "30 June 2027" and "1 September 2027" but that page is for a different programme. No applicationChannel could be quoted for this programme: the DAAD page only says "Submit application via Please check this website", and the only application portal URL supplied (applybachelors.frankfurt-school.de/aide) belongs to the other bachelor programme. No documents fact could be quoted: the document list with "A Recognised secondary school diploma", "A Curriculum Vitae (CV, résumé)", "A copy of your passport or ID card" appears only on the Artificial Intelligence & Data Engineering page, not on the Computational Business Analytics page.
